asked.item: Is there a 100 MB limit on Drive files
Google virus scan warning page on 350 MB video

verdict.reason: The pages say there is no 100 MB Drive cutoff, and they give the direct URL format and the alternatives for the virus-scan warning page.

steps.text: That isn't true: Blotato does not impose a 100 MB Google Drive cutoff.
The file still has to fit your Blotato plan's upload limit and the destination platform's media limit.
For large Drive videos, replace the share link with https://drive.usercontent.google.com/download?id={FILE_ID}&export=download&confirm=t, using the ID from your share link.
If that direct download URL still returns the warning page, use the Presigned Upload flow, frame.io, AWS S3, or Google Cloud Storage, which avoid the Google Drive warning page.
